title: 德莱文·胡子茶会
description: 德莱文保留夸张黑发与小胡子，穿整齐外衣，在镜前整理围巾，双斧静挂支架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Draven is an adult man with dramatically swept dark hair, a pointed curled moustache, expressive eyebrows, and a confident showman's grin. Keep his red-black Noxian costume accents, fur shoulder trim, gloves, and boots, adding a fully closed shirt and opaque trousers. His two distinctive crescent-edged axes hang securely on a display stand, never spinning or being thrown.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a small dressing table and checks a neatly tied scarf in a plain oval mirror, one hand smoothing its end with theatrical satisfaction. A teacup and little comb rest nearby. The paired axes stay motionless behind the table, and the original pose emphasizes humorous vanity instead of arena performance.
art_direction.palette: brick red, dark brown, ivory, warm gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
